extracted.name: Jalapeño Bread
extracted.description: Jalapeños and Monterey Jack cheese team up in this easy bread machine recipe resulting in a loaf of spicy bread that might just clear your sinuses.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup warm water (110 degrees F/45 degrees C)
instruction_lines: Place water, Monterey Jack cheese, jalapeño peppers, salt, flour, sugar, and yeast into a bread machine in the order listed, or follow the order recommended by your manufacturer if different.
Remove loaf from the machine after the cycle is done.
